backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. One function body replaced with the same signature. No data touched.

forward_verification.name: function_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'run_health_checks_v1'

forward_verification.name: loop_variable_renamed
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%for v_hc in%' and prosrc not like '%for r in%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'run_health_checks_v1'

rollback.safe_until: always - a function body only; the full admin_crud_audit_v1 rollback removes it

feature_flags.name: admin_health_checks
feature_flags.required_state: Settings > System health > Run all checks calls run_health_checks_v1; the admin build 5bc3d8d already ships the button.

compatibility.evidence: Function body replacement; the previous body raised on every call, so nothing depended on it.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
